report_name: Ransomware Data Exfiltration Surges 275%, Zscaler Reports

threat_actors.name: Ransomware Groups
threat_actors.description: A collective of ransomware groups who have shifted tactics from encryption-focused attacks to large-scale data theft for extortion. These groups are increasingly targeting employees in privileged roles and using Generative AI to accelerate their operations.
threat_actors.goals: Data theft for extortion and financial gain.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: Attackers perform encryption-focused attacks, although this tactic is being deprioritized in favor of data exfiltration.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Attackers are prioritizing massive data theft over simple encryption, with the volume of exfiltrated data increasing by over 275% to nearly 900 terabytes for extortion purposes.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Attackers use social engineering and phishing, enhanced by Generative AI, to target employees, particularly those in manager-level roles or above.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Access Software
attack_patterns.description: Threat actors abuse legitimate remote access tools like Quick Assist to gain control of victim systems.

attack_patterns.name: Generative AI
attack_patterns.description: Attackers are using Generative AI to craft more convincing phishing emails, develop polymorphic malware, and accelerate the analysis of stolen data to find valuable information for extortion.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.description: Abused by threat actors for social engineering and internal communication within victim organizations.

tools.name: Quick Assist
tools.description: Legitimate Microsoft tool abused by attackers for remote access to victim systems.

identities.name: Privileged Employees
identities.description: Employees at the manager level or above are increasingly targeted in ransomware-related social engineering due to their greater access and influence.

identities.name: Manufacturing Sector
identities.description: One of the most targeted sectors for ransomware attacks.

identities.name: Technology Sector
identities.description: One of the most targeted sectors for ransomware attacks.

identities.description: Experienced a 725% year-over-year growth in ransomware attacks.

indicators.name: Quick Assist File IOC
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Quick Assist File Creation
id: 9c7d8e1f-a2b3-4c5d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of the Quick Assist executable, which can be abused by threat actors for remote access.
references:
  - https://threatlabz.zscaler.com/blogs/security-research/ransomware-leverage-growing-terabyte-takeaways-threatlabz-2026-ransomware
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-02
tags:
  - attack.t1219
level: low
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\quickassist.exe'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate installation or update of Quick Assist.
indicators.description: Detects the presence of the Quick Assist executable file, which can be abused for remote access.

indicators.name: Suspicious Quick Assist Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Quick Assist Execution
id: 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of Quick Assist (quickassist.exe), which can be abused by threat actors for remote access to victim systems.
references:
  - https://threatlabz.zscaler.com/blogs/security-research/ransomware-leverage-growing-terabyte-takeaways-threatlabz-2026-ransomware
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-02
tags:
  - attack.t1219
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\quickassist.exe'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate use of Quick Assist by IT support or users.
indicators.description: Detects the execution of the Quick Assist tool, which is increasingly abused by threat actors for remote access.
